signal.summary: 这项研究利用仿真或三维场景生成，为具身智能提供训练、测试和安全验证所需的可控环境。

editorial.intro: 这项研究利用仿真或三维场景生成，为具身智能提供训练、测试和安全验证所需的可控环境。
editorial.why_it_matters: 高质量仿真能够降低真实机器人试错成本，但关键在于生成环境是否保留了任务和物理约束。
editorial.watch_next: 继续核对仿真与真实环境之间的差距，以及是否能复现到真实机器人。

evidence.title: Make a Robot Arm Feel Weightless with NVIDIA Holoscan 5
evidence.excerpt: Edge Computing Make a Robot Arm Feel Weightless with NVIDIA Holoscan 5 Build a responsive gravity-compensation loop with Pinocchio, a Seeed Studio reBot arm, using a simple Holoscan graph in Python or C++ Nov 09, 2026 By Jay Carlson and Ansley Dunn Discuss (0) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary NVIDIA Holoscan 5 enables low-latency robotic control and high-throughput perception in a single programming model with execution paths for CPU and GPU workloads. A gravity-compensation loop built from three custom Holoscan operators reads joint state at 400 Hz, computes inverse dynamics with Pinocchio , and sends torque commands to the Seeed Studio reBot Arm B601-DM using the motorbridge library. Holoscan partitions group the operators on one thread to avoid cross-thread handoffs, and drop-oldest queues prevent outdated samples from accumulating. Nsight Systems profiling with built-in NVTX annotations shows pinning the control partition to a CPU core reduces p99.99 latency by roughly 5x for C++ and 9.6x for Python implementations.
